audit.whatIsWrong: The prose claims 'Levels 4-5 are your strongest pure-laning window' and 'You own the 1v1 all game', but this entry's own level chart gives Teemo levels 2, 3, 6 and 7 and calls 4-5 a skill matchup. The mirror at audits/top/teemo__akshan.json independently calls levels 4-5 Teemo's firmest control window.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank. Heroic Swing is 18 seconds at rank 1. Teemo gets more than two blinds per swing, which is why the chart does not credit Akshan with those stages. The prose was writing a lane the data and the mirror both disagree with, and the two directions must not contradict.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are a stand-off decided by whether Blinding Dart is up, not an Akshan takeover.

audit.why: Lvl 2-3 double-shot, Lvl 6 Comeuppance, Youmuu's, and Teemo's late shroom/poison scaling are the right four spikes. Their contents needed the blind correction but their placement is sound.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Heroic Swing as a way to escape the blind — 'swing off a lane wall to chip without eating his autos', 'arc off a wall to dodge his autos'. Heroic Swing fires repeatedly while swinging, and those shots are attacks, so Blinding Dart turns the entire swing into a free ride. The mirror states the same thing from Teemo's side.
audit.why: Riot's text for Heroic Swing: he 'swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging.' Blinding Dart blinds the target for its duration. Advising the reader to swing INTO an available blind inverts the correct play. What the blind genuinely cannot stop is Avengerang, which is the ability the entry should be building the lane around.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart (7s flat at every rank) kills your autos and the shots you fire mid-swing. Avengerang is unaffected — it is your blind-proof damage. Swing only after the dart is spent. Heroic Swing also needs terrain to hook, so an open lane denies it entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either side of the central interaction.
audit.why: Blinding Dart never ranks down from 7s; Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. The ratio is the matchup and it belongs on the page.
audit.corrected: 7s flat vs 18s at rank 1 — two blinds per swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Comeuppance stopping on the first body in line is absent, and so is the reason shrooms hurt Going Rogue specifically.
audit.why: Comeuppance hits 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit', so Teemo body-blocks with a caster minion. Going Rogue only holds camouflage in brush or near terrain, which is exactly where mushrooms go — the mirror reached the same conclusion.

edits.after: Blind your autos and your mid-swing shots every 7s flat with Blinding Dart

edits.before: Swing (E) off lane walls to dodge his autos and the Toxic Shot poison they carry while chipping him
edits.after: Swing (E) off lane walls only once Blinding Dart is spent — blind kills the shots you fire mid-arc

edits.before: Your passive double-shot at 2 and Heroic Swing at 3 out-trade his Q-blind poke — Q in, weave the second shot before he can re-blind, and swing off a lane wall to chip without eating his autos.
edits.after: Your passive double-shot at 2 and Heroic Swing at 3 only land with his 7s Blinding Dart down — blind kills the shots you fire mid-swing as well as your autos. Avengerang is the blind-proof button.

edits.before: Heroic Swing at 3 lets you arc off a wall to dodge his autos and the poison they carry while chipping — he has no dash to escape the swing.
edits.after: Heroic Swing at 3 needs a wall to hook and 18s to return, and Blinding Dart erases every shot you fire mid-arc — swing once the dart is spent.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak laning: Q poke plus the move speed on champion hits lets you stick, and his blind can't stop every trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a stand-off: Blinding Dart is 7s flat at every rank, so he re-blinds twice per Heroic Swing — trade only in the gaps.

edits.before: Level 1 is a coinflip — you have only Q and one passive shot, and his Q blind cancels your autos, so last-hit at Avengerang range and don't step into his auto range to fish a trade. From level 2 your second passive shot tips it: throw Q for the out-and-back damage, weave the double-shot, and bait his blind before you commit. At 3 your Heroic Swing lets you arc off a lane wall to dodge his autos and the Toxic Shot poison they apply while still chipping him — he has no dash, so once you reach him he can't peel you off.
edits.after: Level 1 is a coinflip — you have only Q and one passive shot, and Blinding Dart cancels your autos, so last-hit at Avengerang range and don't step in to fish a trade. From level 2 your second passive shot tips it, but only in the 7s gaps: throw Q for the out-and-back damage, which the blind cannot touch, then weave the double-shot once the dart is spent. At 3 Heroic Swing arcs off a lane wall, but the shots it fires are blindable too — swing to close or to leave, never to poke into an available dart.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your strongest pure-laning window — your Q poke and the move speed it grants on champion hits let you stick on him, and his kite can't out-damage your double-shot trades while his Q is down. The whole rhythm is reading his blind: when it's on cooldown, Q in, swing (E) off a wall for the damage, and force him to give up the wave or burn Flash. At 6 your R doesn't flip a brawl but it executes — once your Q poke has him below half, lock Comeuppance from range and the missing-HP scaling deletes a Teemo with no escape and no shield.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a knife-edge, not a takeover. Blinding Dart is 7s flat at every rank while Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — that is two blinds per swing, and the blind kills the shots you fire mid-arc as well as your autos. The whole rhythm is reading it: step up only in the gap, force him to spend it on a walk-up, and lean on Avengerang, the one button blind never touches. At 6 your R doesn't flip a brawl but it executes — get him below half with boomerang chip first, then lock Comeuppance from range on a Teemo with no dash and no shield.

edits.before: You own the 1v1 all game, but Teemo turns into a map problem the way he does for any melee — shrooms zone your camouflaged W roams and his Toxic Shot poison plus mushroom DPS out-grinds your lethality in any drawn-out fight. Your damage is a burst window, not sustained, so a fed Teemo with items kites you and his shrooms wall off every flank. Convert your early-to-mid lead into the tower and a snowball before ~25 minutes; never facecheck brush near objectives, and don't chase him through a minefield.
edits.after: You do not own this 1v1 the way the burst suggests. Toxic Shot poison and mushroom DPS out-grind your lethality in anything drawn out, and shrooms sit on exactly the brush and terrain Going Rogue needs to hold camouflage, so they cost you the roam game too. Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure in line, so he only has to stand behind a caster. Convert the Youmuu's window into the tower before ~25 minutes; never facecheck brush, and don't chase through a minefield.

edits.before: Late, his shrooms and Toxic Shot out-grind your burst and zone your camo roams — your lethality falls off, so the long game evens out.
edits.after: Late, shrooms strip the brush and terrain Going Rogue needs for camouflage and Toxic Shot out-grinds your burst — the long game is his.

notes: The entry told the reader to use Heroic Swing to dodge Teemo's autos. Heroic Swing fires attacks while swinging, so Blinding Dart shuts the whole swing down — swinging into an available dart is the exact opposite of the correct play, and the mirror at audits/top/teemo__akshan.json states the same interaction from Teemo's side. Avengerang is the ability blind cannot stop and the lane should be built on it. I also brought the prose into line with this entry's own level chart and with the mirror: the page claimed Akshan owns levels 4-5 and the 1v1 all game while the chart gives those stages to Teemo or calls them even. I changed the prose, not the chart, since chart and mirror already agree.
